entities.summary: Vladimir Micov is a Serbian basketball executive and former professional basketball player who is currently the sporting director for Galatasaray MCT Technic of the Turkish Basketbol Süper Ligi (BSL) and the FIBA Champions League (BCL). Standing at a height of 2.03 m, he mainly played as a small forward.
